verdict.rationale: Synctera documents creating and managing customer accounts across multiple types, including SAVING and CHECKING demand deposit accounts. That is a thin basis for per-customer account provisioning. The evidence never mentions issuing account or routing numbers, virtual accounts for reconciliation, or sub-accounts under a master structure. Missing for 10: explicit account/routing number issuance, virtual accounts for reconciliation, master/sub-account hierarchy, evidence of scale, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue unique account and routing numbers at scale — virtual accounts for reconciliation, per-customer collection accounts, and sub-accounts under a master structure

citations.quote: SAVING and CHECKING are Demand Deposit Accounts (DDA)
